value.name: wallet-decoder
value.premises: Public layout operations and closed genesis RPC reads share the WALLET devnet owner. RPC configuration, connection details and cookie bytes are secret-owned, and the Basic field leaves its carrier only under its caveat; received heads and bodies are public service data held as ordinary bytes; role-only formatting and typed local failures expose no private fields. Under the host-secured path, Elements is a trusted service and parsed chain objects and diagnostics are public. Trace retains complete public input and result; default records outcomes and refusal diagnostics. No signing, verification, spending or recognition authority is admitted.
